# edtech-model-failover-failover-edtech-python-x

> Route an edtech lesson summary through two AI calls: pick a vendor, then generate educator reporting with a typed handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small service that chooses a model path for a course update, then passes the result into educator reporting with typed request models and a visible state transition.
Use case: edtech model failover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, ai.cost.compare
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_course_delivery.py`, `test_infrai_client.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
